g.text: Concentration alone is not a violation. The system does not punish it —
it measures whether concentration is sliding into capture.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Three different things, one is dangerous

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: A highly competent, trusted member becoming influential is concentration, not a problem by itself. Capture is the narrower, genuinely

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: dangerous zone — reachable from unchecked concentration or from corruption alike.
